description: This Java class defines a FreeMarker template method for setting context fields within a web application, specifically for the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with FreeMarker environment variables and manipulates a context map.

classes.name: SetContextFieldTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker method implementation for setting a key-value pair in the web application's context.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the method to set a context field based on provided arguments, handling different types of values.
